test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 16

questions.question: If a dishonest shopkeeper claims to sell millets at a specific cost price but uses a faulty weight and thus gains 30%, find the weight of millets he actually gives per kilogram for which a customer pays. (Round the answer to the nearest whole number.)
The cost price of a box of chalk is ₹4,600. The shopkeeper gave 86% discount on the cost price. What will be the selling price (in ₹)?
In a factory, the production of scooters increased from 20,000 to 54,880 in 3 years. Assuming the rate of growth is the same every year, find the annual rate of growth (in per cent).
A sells a laptop to B at a loss of 22% and B sells the laptop to C at a profit of 25%. If C purchased the laptop for ₹7,215, then what was the cost (in ₹) of the laptop for A?2542
The simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3,000 at the rate of 6% per annum in 4 years is:
7% of a number is what percentage of 4% of the same number?
The least number which should be added to 2564 so that the sum is exactly divisible by 2, 4, 6 and 3 is _____.17
Amit's income in 2019 was ₹26,000. He gets an increment of 10% every year. What was his income (in ₹) in 2021?7730

A 200 m long train overtakes a man moving at a speed of 10 km/hr (in same direction) in 20 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will it take this train to completely cross another 350 m long train, moving in the opposite direction at a speed of 86 km/hr?8169
The diameter of a sphere is 21 cm. Find its surface area.
A man goes to Vasai-Virar from Varanasi at a speed of 30 km/hr and returns to Varanasi at speed of 45 km/hr, through same route. What is his average speed (in km/hr) of the entire journey?5015
The marked price of a toy tractor is ₹7,390, and it is sold for ₹1,370. Calculate the discount percentage. (Round off the answer to two decimal places.)
The arithmetic mean of the observations 36, 76, 61, 25, 15, 61, 97, 65 and 14 is:
The wages of three workers are in the ratio 7 : 4 : 3. If the increments of 10%, 15% and 20% are allowed, respectively, in their wages, then what will be new ratio of their wages?
The average of 13 numbers is 8. If each of these numbers is multiplied by 3, then what will the new average be?
The total surface areas of two hemispheres are 286 sq. cm and 1144 sq. cm, respectively. Find the ratio of their radii.
The ratio of the scores of A and B is 5 : 7 and that of B and C is 8 : 11. If A’s score is 80, what is C’s score?

Two cyclists, A and B, are participating in a 100 km race. Cyclist A starts the race 20 minutes after Cyclist B. Cyclist A rides at a constant speed of 30 km/hr, while Cyclist B rides at a constant speed of 24 km/hr. However, to compensate for the late start, Cyclist A is allowed a head start of 5 kilometres (i.e., he starts 20 minutes late but begins from the 5 km mark, not the starting line). Who among A and B finishes the race first, and by how many minutes?
options: Cyclist A finishes the race 40 minutes before Cyclist B.
Cyclist B finishes the race 20 minutes before Cyclist A.
Cyclist B finishes the race 40 minutes before Cyclist A.
Cyclist A finishes the race 20 minutes before Cyclist B.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Cyclist A finishes the race 40 minutes before Cyclist B.) है।

questions.question: Find the interest (in ₹) on ₹500 at 15% per annum for 2 years 4 months, where the interest is compounded annually for the first two years, and on the amount accrued at the end of two years, simple interest at the same rate is offered for the remaining four months. [Give the answer correct to two decimal places.]

There are 30 students in a class. The average weight of 5 of them is 57 kg, of 10 other students is 54 kg, of 12 others is 50 kg, and of the remaining 3 students is 65 kg. Determine the average weight (in kg) of all the students in the class.
